releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.7.0 (Precision Text Replacement, Multi-Word OCR Tokenizer & Typography Matching)
changelog:
🚀 Major Pro Release v10.7.0:
• Zero-Concatenation Text Input: Selection now automatically covers the entire word on tap, plus instant 1-tap Clear (✕) and quick case-change chips (UPPERCASE, lowercase, Capitalize, Reset).
• Multi-Word OCR Tokenizer: Compound elements (e.g. [D WHOLE]) are now cleanly split into individual words with sub-bounding boxes for 1-tap single-word selection.
• Document-Level Typography Matching: Diagnostic reports and formal documents automatically resolve to true Times New Roman (Serif) with realistic paper noise and toner blending.
• Reflow & Exact Bounding Box: Replaced words no longer shrink to 50% or stretch the bounding box across the screen. Subsequent words push forward naturally with zero distortion.
